definition.rw: Ni imbago zose z’imihanda minini, amabarabara, aho abantu nyamwinshi bahurira, aho imodoka nyinshi zihagarara, inzira n’utuyira two ku muhanda, ibiraro, ibyombo, muri rusange imihanda nyabagendwa igendwamo ku butaka
definition.en: All major roads, avenues, public gathering places, vehicle parking areas, paths and lanes along the road, bridges and ferries — in general, the public ways used to travel over land.
definition.fr: L'ensemble des grandes routes, avenues, lieux de rassemblement du public, aires de stationnement, chemins et sentiers de la route, ponts et bacs — en général, les voies publiques empruntées pour circuler sur terre.

provenance.note: Kinyarwanda taken from source; en/fr to be authored against the consolidated road code. Never machine-translate.

definition.rw: Ni igice cy’inzira nyabagerwa kinyurwamo n’ibinyabiziga ikaba yagira imihanda myinshi
definition.en: The part of the public thoroughfare used by vehicles; a road may comprise several carriageways.
definition.fr: La partie de la voie publique empruntée par les véhicules ; une route peut comporter plusieurs chaussées.

provenance.note: Kinyarwanda taken from source; en/fr to be authored against the consolidated road code. Never machine-translate.

definition.en: The road together with the ways that border it.
definition.fr: La route et les voies qui la bordent.

definition.rw: Kimwe mu bisate bigabanyije umuhanda mu burebure bwawo
definition.en: One of the strips into which a road is divided along its length.
definition.fr: L'une des bandes qui divisent la route dans le sens de la longueur.

provenance.note: Kinyarwanda taken from source; en/fr to be authored against the consolidated road code. Never machine-translate.

definition.rw: Igice cy’inzira nyabagerwa cyahariwe amagare na velomoteri kigaragazwa n’ikimenyetso cyabigenewe
definition.en: The part of the thoroughfare set aside for cycles and mopeds, shown by the appropriate sign.
definition.fr: La partie de la voie publique réservée aux cycles et cyclomoteurs, indiquée par le panneau approprié.

provenance.note: Kinyarwanda taken from source; en/fr to be authored against the consolidated road code. Never machine-translate.

definition.fr: Tout lieu où des routes se rejoignent.

definition.en: The point where one road runs into another.
definition.fr: L'endroit où une route débouche sur une autre.

provenance.note: Kinyarwanda taken from source; en/fr to be authored against the consolidated road code. Never machine-translate.

definition.rw: Inzira ifunganye yagenewe abanyamaguru, ibinyabiziga by’ibiziga bibiri
definition.en: A narrow way intended for pedestrians and two-wheeled vehicles.
definition.fr: Une voie étroite réservée aux piétons et aux véhicules à deux roues.

provenance.note: Kinyarwanda taken from source; en/fr to be authored against the consolidated road code. Never machine-translate.

definition.rw: Inzira nyabagerwa yagutse ariko itanyurwamo n’ibiziga bibiri
definition.en: An unpaved public way, wider than a path but not normally intended for two vehicles side by side.
definition.fr: Une voie non revêtue, plus large qu'un sentier mais qui n'est normalement pas destinée à deux véhicules de front.

provenance.note: Kinyarwanda taken from source; en/fr to be authored against the consolidated road code. Never machine-translate.

definition.rw: Ahantu hari amazu yegeranye cg afatanye
definition.en: An area where the buildings stand close together or adjoin one another.
definition.fr: Une zone où les bâtiments sont rapprochés ou contigus.

provenance.note: Kinyarwanda taken from source; en/fr to be authored against the consolidated road code. Never machine-translate.

definition.rw: Ni umuntu wese utwaye ikinyabiziga cg uyobora mu nzira nyabagerwa inyamaswa cg amatungo
definition.en: Any person driving a vehicle, or leading or herding animals, on the public road.
definition.fr: Toute personne qui conduit un véhicule ou qui mène des animaux sur la voie publique.

definition.rw: Umukozi wambaye mu buryo bugarara imyenda iranga imirimo ashinzwe
definition.en: An officer wearing the clearly visible uniform of the duty they are responsible for.
definition.fr: Un agent portant l'uniforme bien visible de la fonction dont il est chargé.

provenance.note: Kinyarwanda taken from source; en/fr to be authored against the consolidated road code. Never machine-translate.

definition.rw: Igikoresho cyose gikoreshwa mu gutwara ibintu n’abantu ku butaka, igihingishwa, gikoreshwa mu nganda n’ahandi
definition.en: Any device used to carry goods or people over land, to till the soil, or for industrial and other uses.
definition.fr: Tout engin servant à transporter des biens ou des personnes sur terre, à labourer, ou utilisé dans l'industrie et ailleurs.

definition.rw: Ikinyabiziga cyose kigendeshwa n’ingufu z’abantu nk’igare,…
definition.en: Any vehicle propelled by human power, such as a bicycle.
definition.fr: Tout véhicule mû par la force humaine, comme une bicyclette.
